input_chunk.content: I still think about that Shanghai trip in 2025—everyone kept hyping up the food scene there.
Getting there was a whole story too—I was coming from Beijing to Shanghai, and it felt like half my office was on the same route.
And yeah, the hotel situation in Shanghai was fine in the end, but I remember we compared a bunch of places back then.
For the flight, my coworker had already booked me on China Eastern—flight MU5678—for 2025-03-13, under Zhang Wei, so I didn’t touch any of it.
